evals.prompt: I'm making a habit tracker app called Sprout and our mascot is a little seed: a round, light brown seed shape with a tiny green sprout leaf on top, dot eyes and rosy cheeks. Can you make me a happy hop animation for when someone completes a habit, and an idle loop for the home screen? It's an iOS app so I need clips I can drop into Xcode, with a transparent background.
evals.expected_output: A seed mascot with a leaf part, rendered as a ~1 s hop and a seamless ~4 s idle loop, encoded as HEVC-with-alpha .mov files (plus stills/previews), saved to the outputs folder.
assertions: A hop clip is delivered as an HEVC .mov (hvc1) for Xcode
The hop .mov keeps a transparent background when decoded by AVFoundation
The hop clip lasts between 0.5 and 1.6 s
An idle clip is delivered as an HEVC .mov (hvc1) for Xcode
The idle .mov keeps a transparent background when decoded by AVFoundation
The idle clip lasts between 2.0 and 6.0 s
The idle clip loops: its first and last frames match (PSNR >= 30 dB)
A still PNG (for Reduce Motion or a poster) is delivered
The mascot is a round light brown seed with a green leaf on top, dot eyes and rosy cheeks (visual)

evals.prompt: here's our mascot as an svg path (it's a cloud): M 300 600 C 200 600 150 520 190 450 C 160 360 250 290 330 320 C 370 220 520 200 580 290 C 660 250 770 300 760 400 C 850 420 860 560 760 600 Z. white cloud, navy outline, two little eyes. we need a 'surprised' reaction and a loading spinner for our website, transparent so it sits on any background color
evals.expected_output: A cloud mascot built from the given path, a surprised clip and a seamless spinner loop, encoded as WebM with alpha (and ideally HEVC for Safari), saved to the outputs folder.
assertions: A surprised clip is delivered as VP9 WebM for the web
The surprised WebM keeps its alpha (transparent corner when decoded)
A spinner clip is delivered as VP9 WebM for the web
The spinner WebM keeps its alpha (transparent corner when decoded)
The spinner is a short seamless loop (at most 2 s; its last frame is close to its first, PSNR >= 18 dB)
An HEVC-with-alpha .mov is also delivered for Safari
The body is built from the SVG path the user gave
An HTML snippet plays the clips in a <video> with a WebM source
The mascot reads as a white cloud with a navy outline and two eyes (visual)

evals.prompt: Our fintech app's mascot is a gold coin with a smiley face, thick black outline, flat colours, kind of sticker-ish. Make me a launch animation for the splash screen at full phone size (1080x2340), plus a dark mode version for black backgrounds.
evals.expected_output: A gold sticker coin with a face, an entrance/splash clip at 1080x2340 in a light version and a dark-mode version, both with transparent backgrounds, saved to the outputs folder.
assertions: A light splash clip is delivered at 1080x2340
The light splash keeps a transparent background
The light splash lasts between 1.2 and 3.5 s
The light splash settles: its last two frames match (PSNR >= 35 dB)
A dark splash clip is delivered at 1080x2340
The dark splash keeps a transparent background
The dark splash lasts between 1.2 and 3.5 s
The dark splash settles: its last two frames match (PSNR >= 35 dB)
The mascot is a gold coin with a smiley face and a thick black outline, flat and sticker-like (visual)
The dark version reads clearly on black (visual)
